@Gideon, the first report in #inc-vtg-hartford is your message at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**: gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant, both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan. Nothing earlier appears in the channel.

While the kiosks were down, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard, per that same 10:42 message. Mateo's 11:03 AM message adds that the guard checked in trailer 8836 once kiosk 1 was back, and dispatch could see it. You confirmed both lanes were working at 11:07 (posted 11:08).
